description: Get a VIA Personal Shopper for the calling Mind's owner. From a name and email it emails the owner a confirmation link; when they confirm, their VIA Personal Shopper is created, with its own wallet and on-chain (ERC-8004) identity that reads the whole VIA network and can buy for them within limits they set. Nothing is created until the owner confirms the email. No payment and no wallet signature. Pass your own Mind id as mind_id: each Mind gets exactly ONE shopper. Returns pending_verification until the owner confirms; after that, a repeat call returns the shopper and an appraisal_link_token: if you have the owner's email connected, appraise how they shop and call import_preference_appraisal with this token to train the shopper from day one.

email.description: The person's email. The confirmation link is sent here; their agent, wallet and identity are created for this address when they confirm.

mind_id.description: The calling Mind's own unique id on the Minds platform. The one-shopper-per-Mind cap is keyed on this; pass your real id.

name.description: The person's name, used as their agent display name.

name: get_personal_shopper
